name: Graystar
summary: A black-and-white review desk with an ink-filled rating star, replies, topics and a site widget
about: A complete review management dashboard for a restaurant group, set like a newspaper in black, white and grey with a light and a dark edition. The front page fills a big star with ink up to the average rating, reviews can be answered in place with suggested replies, and branches, review requests, a topic cloud, an embeddable widget, competitors and a monthly report sit in their own sections. Good for marketplaces and service businesses.
how: Watch the ink star fill to the average rating on the front page, with the star breakdown beside it.
Filter reviews by stars, branch, source or waiting ones, then click Reply, pick a suggested reply or write your own and post it.
Mark reviews resolved, tag them with topics, or report a fake one.
Open a branch to see its own rating breakdown, and edit or add branches.
Send review requests by SMS or email and print the QR table card.
Click a word in the topic cloud to read every review that mentions it.
Build the website widget (grid, sliding row or badge) and copy the embed code; compare yourself with competitors.
